title: Tidings for the Season
overview: A local newscaster’s life changes when he meets a 10-year-old fan — and his single mother — during the holidays.

title: Scouting for Christmas
overview: Busy realtor and single mom Angela meets bakery owner William after her daughter tries to set them up by having him cater her scout troop’s holiday event.

title: Inventing the Christmas Prince
overview: Shelby is about to quit her job as a rocket engineer when her daughter becomes convinced that her Scrooge-like boss, Evan, is the Christmas Prince from a story Shelby invented years ago.

title: The Santa Stakeout
overview: Tanya is a police detective who is reluctantly partnered with fellow detective Ryan to solve a recent string of heists taking place during high-profile holiday parties around town.

title: Christmas Comes Twice
overview: When Cheryl visits the Christmas carnival in her hometown, she gets a second chance in life when she is transported to Christmas five years in the past.
